title: Product Management Intern
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Product Management Intern
 



**Location:** 
 Kochi, Kerala (On\-site)
 



**Employment Type** 
 : Paid Internship
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹5,000 – ₹10,000 per month (based on skills and performance)
 



**Duration:** 
 6 Months
 



  





**About Fawrit**




 Fawrit Technologies India Pvt. Ltd. is a multinational technology company based in Kochi,
 



 focused on building digital products for international markets. Our current product focus is Dancing Drops, a technology\-enabled laundry platform serving the Spain market. The platform connects customers, laundry partners, riders, and operations teams through a seamless booking and service management system.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are looking for a motivated and curious Product Management Intern who is eager to learn
 



 how successful digital products are built, improved, and scaled. As a Product Management Intern, you will work closely with the Founder and cross\-functional teams to understand user needs, analyze product challenges, support feature development, conduct testing, and contribute to product execution.
 



 This internship offers hands\-on exposure to real\-world product management within a fast\-paced
 



 startup environment and is ideal for individuals looking to build a career in Product
 



 Management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




 ● Understand customer, business, and operational challenges
 



 ● Analyze app and web user flows to identify areas for improvement
 



 ● Assist in preparing product requirements, user stories, and feature documentation
 



 ● Test new features and report bugs or issues clearly
 



 ● Coordinate with developers, designers, and operations teams
 



 ● Gather, organize, and analyze user and stakeholder feedback
 



 ● Track product enhancements and follow up on action items
 



 ● Support product decision\-making through observation, research, and basic data analysis
 



  





**Eligibility**




 Final\-year students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply
 



 Candidates from any academic background with a strong interest in Product
 



 Management, technology, and startups are welcome to apply
 



  





**Requirements**




 Strong interest in Product Management, technology, and startups
 



 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 



 Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
 



 Ability to understand user needs and think from a customer perspective
 



 Comfortable with documentation, testing, customer interactions, and team coordination
 



 Willingness to work from our Kochi office
 



 Ability to commit to a 6\-month internship
 



 Immediate joiners preferred
 



  





**Good to Have**




 Basic understanding of mobile applications and web platforms
 



 Familiarity with tools such as Google Docs, Google Sheets, Notion, Figma, Trello, Jira,
 



 or similar platforms
 



 Interest in startups, marketplaces, logistics, or service\-based products
 



 Ability to create simple product flows, wireframes, or documentation
 



  





**Internship Details**




 Location: Kochi, Kerala
 



 Work Mode: On\-site (Work from Office)
 



 Duration: 6 Months
 



 Stipend: ₹5,000 – ₹10,000 per month (based on skills, performance, and evaluation)
 



  





**Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





 Potential for full\-time employment upon successful completion of the internship, subject
 



 to individual performance and business requirements
 



  





**Selection Process**




 Shortlisted candidates will undergo a practical evaluation designed to assess their product
 



 thinking, communication skills, problem\-solving ability, and overall fit for the role.
 


* Further details regarding the selection process will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

Your extensive experience in these fields will be invaluable as you collaborate with cross\-functional teams, lead transformative projects, and drive organizational growth and innovation. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of project management methodologies, change management principles, and design thinking frameworks, along with exceptional leadership, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Collaborate with Executive Leadership to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and guide teams toward successful outcomes
* Manage \& engage senior stakeholder relationships at CxO, Partner, Functional Head levels
* Perform rapid assessment of landscape for stakeholders and provide insights to accelerate action towards refining their current state
* Bring diverse and thought\-provoking perspective to transformations, including market trends, new and innovative ideas to drive data driven decision making
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a strategic mindset and attention to detail
* Drive and build upon a culture of continuous improvement by developing innovative idea
* Conduct comprehensive analyses of organization’s processes and systems
* Provide strategic recommendations and action plans to drive business performance and transformation
* Develop roadmaps for implementing project management, Organizational change management, and design thinking initiatives.
* Lead and manage complex projects from initiation to closure, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with clients and stakeholders
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies
* Foster effective communication and collaboration among project teams and stakeholders
* Develop and implement change management strategies to support organizational transformation initiatives
* Conducting Change Impact Analysis and Change Readiness / Gap Assessment and give recommendations that are actionable on immediate and long\-term basis
* Build strong change network, drive change adoption, manage stakeholders with people centric approach, if needed work towards mindset shift and achieve cultural transformation
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of change management efforts and make adjustments as necessary
* Apply design thinking principles and methodologies to identify innovative solutions to complex business problems
* Conduct user research, gather insights, and define user personas and journeys.
* Advocate for design thinking principles and foster a culture of creativity and experimentation within client organizations
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of consulting methodologies and frameworks
* Mentor and coach junior consultants, providing guidance and support in their professional growth


**What will make you eligible for this role?**
* Master’s degree in business administration, management, or a related field
* 10\+ Years of experience with at least 7\+ years of management / business consulting experience
* Advance MS Suite skills – particularly, to develop engaging presentations and dashboards
* Professional certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional), certification in Change Management or Design Thinking are highly desirable.
* Deep understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and their practical application in different contexts.
* Extensive knowledge of change management principles, models, and methodologies, with hands\-on experience leading change initiatives.
* Proficiency in design thinking frameworks and tools, with the ability to apply them effectively to solve complex business problems.
* Awareness and experience of leveraging technology as enablers
* Exceptional communication, presentation skills with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences


**Good to have**
* Experience working in the Big 4 professional services firms and other global management consultancies is highly desirable
* MBA or equivalent advanced education is preferable
* Certification in Project Management, Organisational Change Management, Design Thinking, Facilitation will be an advantage


**What working at EY offers?**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

**Job Title:** 
 Report Advisor – Financials Product Line
   

  

**Function:** 
 Finance
   

  

**Sub\-function:** 
 Reporting \& Data Analytics – FP\&A
   

  

**Duration:** 
 Permanent
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Report Advisor reports to the product line’s senior report advisor and focuses primarily on the end\-user and key influential stakeholder groups who either use or have an interest in the solutions. Together with the Product Line lead the Report Advisors represents the face of one reporting product line within the Reporting and Data Analytics sub\-function (R\&DA). A reporting product line represents a set of reporting and analysis tools and reports that are designed for a certain R\&DA customer group to manage and operate their own responsibility within EY. The Financials product line is focused on business management roles as well as their appropriate Finance teams managing certain organizational entities from a Profit \& Loss Statement as well as from employee \& utilization perspective. Essentials for Financials, Profit \& Loss statements as well as People Flash reporting are the primary reporting tools within this product line. The main responsibility is to increase the usage and adoption of the tools, understand changing business needs and feed them into continuous improvement process of the solution, supporting improvements and spreading a positive message while interacting with the different stakeholders.
   

  

 The Reporting and Data Analytics sub\-function is a leading\-edge organization providing powerful analytical solutions to evolve our ability to provide insights to the business. The R\&DA ensures that EY is keeping pace with the many analytical and technological changes taking place in the business world, evolving our tools and the way we consume information, to best support the client serving as well as corporate responsibilities in a rapidly changing business world.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Work hand\-in\-hand with the senior report advisor as well as functional and technical support teams
* Support shaping the vision of the product offering in collaboration with product line lead and senior report advisor based on the overall Finance and R\&DA strategy
* Focus on adoption and awareness of the solutions to increase usage
* Establish, maintain and leverage a reliable network with actual target audience as well as various stakeholder groups to gain insights on what the business needs and what is changing
* Identify potential enhancements or new critical topics based on interactions with the networks
* Act as a change agent and a spokesperson for the entire offering within the product line and focus on the intended user of the tool and be visible and approachable
* Share insights on current state of solutions, how they are being used and take an active role in the discussions on future enhancements
* Partner with more technically oriented Business Analysts within the product line team to drive towards user friendly, business focused and consistent solutions, designs and visualizations
* Actively support global training activities, support regional efforts and manage customer communities
* Prepare product line communications about upcoming updates, enhancements or issues, in alignment with R\&DA’s overarching communication strategy
* Partner and regularly discuss with other product lines to ensure consistency, leverage new developments, ideas or change in technology but also share best practices regarding communication, networks and training
* Prepare and actively collaborate in meetings with other functions, local teams or within the R\&DA to solve open topics, propose innovate solutions and link the product line team into other initiatives, campaigns or projects


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Have conversations based on business processes and questions and with EY’s strategy in mind
* Communicates clearly, assertive and focused on mutually beneficial outcomes
* Good presenter and trainer – act as an influencer or sales person
* Overarching knowledge around the product line offering, EY’s business concepts and rules as well as the strategic objectives
* Establishes and maintains good relationships within the R\&DA, Finance, other functions and Operational Leads as well as stakeholder groups
* Very structured mindset
* Overview of EY’s end\-to\-end processes and customers need to go through and that are critical in reporting (e.g. financial accounting rules and month\-end close activities, controlling, headcount management/utilization, planning) as well EY’s key management structures
* Ability to navigate challenging and complex environments with support of the senior report advisor
* Transform the message from “what the solutions shows” to “how to use the information”, “how to generate insights” and “what actions should be taken next”
* Fluent English skills
* Having the ability to have business conversation in a secondary language, primarily Spanish or Japanese, would be beneficial but not mandatory


**What We Look For**
* Ability to influence and inspire change
* Global and inclusive mindset
* Personality with confidence and credibility
* Innovative mindset being open to new ideas and promoting team members to think outside the box
* Good knowledge of business processes and end\-user needs and their ways of managing their responsibilities
* Challenging customers insightfully to improve process, approach or results
* Apply a deep understanding of customer needs to identify critical outcomes, pain points, barriers to success, and changes in expectations or scope
* Proposing options and making recommendations based on stakeholder feedback
* Driving change efforts and adoption through building and maintaining relationships with end\-users, stakeholders and leadership
* Resolving competing priorities respectful and effectively
* Ability to work both autonomously to achieve project goals, as well as in a team environment with limited direction and supervision
* Using appropriate resources to increase team strengths and decrease costs while meeting deadlines
* Appreciation and respect of varying cultures – both corporate and geographical


**Experience**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
* 5 plus years of experience in a finance or markets/business development department or change management programs
* Relevant business experience
* Good network within EY would be beneficial but isn’t mandatory


**What We Offer**
 The R\&DA sub\-function is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We support customers in all EY locations and across many functions and Service Lines. R\&DA colleagues are in various locations across the Globe with concentration in US, UK, Germany, France, Poland and India. From accountants and programmers to people with consulting, change management or data scientist background, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span various disciplines. In the R\&DA, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands and technologies.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

**Job Overview**
 Requirements ownership (approx. 80%)
   

  

* Own requirements end to end for Module 3 enablement — elicitation, documentation, prioritisation, traceability from business objective through to delivered capability and acceptance.
* Act as the translator between HEOR business stakeholders and the AI\&D and platform engineering teams: convert domain and workflow need into requirements the engineers can build against, and convert technical constraints back into decisions the business can actually make.
* Plan and lead requirements definition working sessions and workshops, bringing the Lead AI Engineer in where feasibility needs to be assessed live rather than discovered later.
* Work with business SMEs to surface nuanced requirements that differ across sections and content types, and document them at a level of precision an engineer can act on without a follow\-up conversation.
* Define acceptance criteria for AI\-generated content — factual grounding, source traceability, completeness against the section template, tone and terminology consistency — in terms the business owns and the engineers can test against.
* Build on the substantial documentation already produced through the POC work rather than restarting discovery. Establish quickly what is complete, what remains, and what is at risk.
* Refine requirements iteratively across the execution period as SME review cycles reveal what the platform can and cannot yet do, without losing the thread of what was originally agreed.


 Delivery coordination (approx. 20%)
   

  

* Hold the pod’s delivery cadence: backlog, sprint rhythm, stand\-ups and review cycles, run in the client’s tooling.
* Sequence work realistically against actual capacity and state clearly what can and cannot be delivered within the pilot window.
* Own weekly progress and status reporting to Amgen — at a level of candour that surfaces problems while they are still cheap to fix.
* Identify, log and escalate blockers, risks and dependencies early, particularly those sitting with the core APEX build team, with source\-content availability, or with SME review capacity.
* Maintain the risk, issue, decision and assumption log for the engagement.


 Stakeholder leadership
   

  

* Hold the day\-to\-day relationship with HEOR subject\-matter experts and the wider business group, and be the single point they come to for scope and progress.
* Coordinate across the three organisations involved — HEOR, AI\&D and the platform team — without formal authority over any of them.
* Push back on requirements, scope additions and timeline expectations where the evidence warrants, with reasoning rather than resistance.
* Protect the engineers’ focus: absorb coordination load, filter noise, and ensure they receive requirements that are decided rather than still being argued.
* Document and hand over requirements, decisions and open items in a form the Amgen team can own after the pilot.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience. 10\+ years in business analysis, business systems analysis or a comparable requirements\-owning role, including a minimum of 3 years on AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent\-automation programmes.
* AI lifecycle fluency. Demonstrable experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle — not a single pilot. Practical understanding of hallucination, non\-determinism, human\-in\-the\-loop requirements and output variability, and how each changes the way requirements must be written.
* Hands\-on GenAI literacy. Working familiarity with GPT/Claude\-class tooling — enough to understand how prompting, templatisation and output structuring work, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about what is and is not achievable.
* Requirements craft. Strong elicitation technique, functional and non\-functional specification, acceptance criteria, and traceability discipline across multiple interconnected workstreams.
* Workshop leadership. Proven ability to plan and lead requirements workshops with senior, non\-technical business stakeholders and drive them to decisions rather than discussion.
* Delivery discipline. Experience running an agile delivery cadence — backlog, sprints, status reporting, risk and dependency management — for a small team.
* Influence without authority. A track record of holding multiple organisations to commitments from outside all of them, evidenced by unblocking programmes rather than documenting them.
* Autonomy. Demonstrated ability to own a workstream and set its working practices without close supervision, in a client\-facing setting.
* Tooling. Proficiency with Jira; familiarity with Smartsheet and SharePoint.
* Communication. Excellent written and verbal English, at the standard required to write for and present to senior commercial stakeholders in the US and Europe, and to disagree constructively.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior delivery within a life sciences, pharmaceutical or biotech commercial organisation — market access, HEOR, medical affairs or commercial analytics. Useful context, but not a screening filter.
* Experience with AI\-assisted document authoring, content generation, knowledge management or large\-scale content transformation.
* Exposure to retrieval\-augmented generation and the requirement implications of grounding and source attribution.
* Familiarity with regulated or GxP\-adjacent documentation environments and their traceability expectations.
* Experience in a self\-directed vendor pod operating alongside, but independently of, a client’s internal build team.
